park-hide-seek.name: Park Hide Seek
park-hide-seek.blurb: All ages! Hide and seek with friends or vs computers in America's National Parks.
park-hide-seek.more:
We feature all the national parks in the USA!
You are either the camper hiding or the ranger trying to find those darn renegade campers!
Choose your drop-in spot. You have some time to hide, then off the rangers run around needing to tag out all the campers!
Find Sasquatch to score BIG!

skate-tech-park.name: Skate Tech Park
skate-tech-park.blurb: Shred America's National Parks on a giant fingerless board!
skate-tech-park.more:
Features all the National Parks in America!
Start out on the rooftop to familiarize yourself with the skating controls.
Then head out to shred out our USA Parks!!

alien-disc-golf.name: Alien Disc Golf
alien-disc-golf.kicker: Aliens use Earth as Disc Golf Course!
alien-disc-golf.blurb: Throw the alien ship across countries and continents. Take into account wind and water!
alien-disc-golf.more:
Uses real NOAA data to influence your game!
Water currents, wind directions!
Careful not to land in the water lest you drift away!

delayed-reaction.name: Delayed Reaction
delayed-reaction.blurb: Listen to the tune to make it through the delay vortex!
delayed-reaction.more:
Music and rhythm based game.
Listen and react!

two-fronts.name: Two Fronts
two-fronts.blurb: Thunder Marines vs Wookas. Control the strategy game & spawn into battles to take command!
two-fronts.more:
The story is based around the story of the Thunder Marines sent in to deal with the bomber bear-like creatures known as Wookas.
Handle the strategy game then choose to take over the space or ground battle.
Do not underestimate the Wooka tribes and their growing threat to the Empire!

git-recon.name: Git Recon
git-recon.blurb: Fight your way through the repo maps to git your commit to merged!
git-recon.more:
Cinematic Third Person shooter played across the real repo's code!
Third Person shooter where you battle across repo levels!

hippo-tycoon.name: Hippo Tycoon
hippo-tycoon.blurb: Pablo's hippos have escaped and the only thing that can satiate then is MORE OIL!

splat-spray.name: Splat Spray
splat-spray.blurb: Shoot your way to seeing the room and find the object!

mythic-masters.name: Mythic Masters
mythic-masters.blurb: Bind folklore beasts and fight them in a 1v1 arena.
mythic-masters.more:
Your favorite cryptids need capturing!
Explore the world and their mythos!

qcrm.name: qCRM
qcrm.blurb: Contacts, deals and webhooks in one quick workspace.

qntbr.name: QNTBR
qntbr.blurb: The QNTBR site, signed in with eqosys.

geoboxq.name: GeoBoxQ
geoboxq.blurb: Will it fit in the box? The smallest shipping box for an order, a box in a box included.
geoboxq.more: visually see the box combinations, now with ultimate performance!
